title: Consent to Treatment
about: General consent for examination and treatment at the clinic.

blocks.text: I agree to be examined, tested and treated by the providers and staff of {facility.name} when they think it is needed for my care. This includes routine tests, lab work, shots and medicines.
I may ask questions about any treatment. I may say no to any treatment. Before some procedures, I will be asked to sign a separate consent.
This consent lasts until I take it back in writing.
